info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Ratings-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Ratings Retrieval API provides access to customer ratings for food delivery services. This API allows stakeholders to analyze feedback and assess the performance of delivery operations by retrieving detailed ratings associated with individual deliveries. It supports use cases such as monitoring service quality, improving customer satisfaction, and driving data-driven decisions in food delivery management. Typical consumers include delivery service operators and analysts looking to enhance operational efficiency through customer insights.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the ratings for deliveries. It provides insights into customer feedback and satisfaction, helping to evaluate the performance of your delivery services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a rating for deliveries. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the delivery and the rating value. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRatingsRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET delivery ratings operation.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the request.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the delivery request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result returned by the operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery rating.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's result.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRatingsRespons.description: Response schema for the delivery rating operation. This schema outlines the structure of the response returned for a successful GET request to the delivery rating endpoint.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.
